name: Jira connector
description: A ready-to-use Jira connector — an example of extending Mockarty toward an external tool with no code. It reuses Mockarty's built-in Jira adapter and ships sensible defaults, so installing it gives you a pre-configured Jira integration in a couple of clicks.

connectors.name: Jira Cloud
connectors.description: Link Mockarty issues, test cases and runs to Jira Cloud. Uses the built-in Jira adapter.
